verdicts.explanation: The ~5×10-5 S cm-1 value is reported for the 7 wt. % TiO2 composite in the abstract and conclusions, with the conclusions stating room temperature, and it is measured in this paper (experimental). The secondary fields are all null and the solution-cast method and EIS measurement match the paper.

Section 3.5.1 states 'The ionic conductivity of polymer blend was 3.3 ×10 -8 S cm-1' for the salt-free PEO-PVC blend, measured in this paper. Section 2.3 says the conductivity was measured at room temperature, so the room-temperature label is supported. The mobile_ion='other' label is not one of the checked fields.
